title: Comparison Between the Effect of (650 nm) and (810 nm) Diode Laser Photobiomodulation as an Adjunctive Therapy for Alveolar Socket Preservation: A Clinical and Radiographic Study Othman M A A-E, Zaky A A, Khalil N M, Eltayeb E A. J. Pharm. Negat. Res
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Under applied conditions and laser parameters; the 650 nm Diode seems to have better effects on soft tissue healing than the 810 nm. However, regarding bone parameters (socket dimensions & bone density), both showed comparable outcomes when used as an adj unctive therapy in alveolar socket preservation procedure” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
